name: AMD GPU Hardware Acceleration
author: Schaka
description: Requires the AudioMuse-AI ROCm worker image; inert on other images. Runs musicnn and the CLAP audio encoder on the AMD GPU via ONNX Runtime's MIGraphX provider, and swaps lyrics ASR to a GPU-backed engine (faster-whisper/CTranslate2, whisper.cpp, or parakeet.cpp) instead of the built-in ONNX Whisper. Per-arch profiles handle generation differences (fp16, blocked backends, etc). Docs: https://github.com/Schaka/audiomuse-rocm-plugin/blob/main/plugin/rocm_accelerator/README.md
changelog: Proof of concept: MIGraphX provider for musicnn + faster-whisper ASR backend.
